# Open choices: release-rollout

`aidd-team:release-rollout` leaves these decisions to the team. aidd's default holds until a `[[standards]]` entry fills one. `aidd standard list` names the library standards for each choice, and `aidd standard add` adopts one.

| Choice | Question | aidd's default | Options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preview-environment-ttl` | When is a preview environment deleted? | Deleted when its pull request closes, and after a set number of days at most, so no preview keeps running unwatched. | when the pull request closes, after a set number of days, scaled to zero when idle |
| `cost-kill-switch` | How does the team cut a path whose cost runs out of control? | A tested runbook that scales the service to zero or turns off the expensive path, rehearsed like a rollback. | a tested scale-to-zero runbook, a kill-switch flag on the expensive path, a provider budget action that stops the resources |
